scope: Distribution step five: IssueLens is public at github.com/ctkuo2438/IssueLens under the MIT license with tag v0.1.0, and uvx installs and starts the MCP server from the GitHub URL in a clean home directory. No settings file existed, so the tool call stopped at the key check; no model or GitHub API request was made. The only network use was uv cloning the repository and downloading Python and packages.

publication.license: MIT, declared in pyproject.toml as license = "MIT" with license-files = ["LICENSE"]
publication.history_rewrite: Before the first push, git-filter-repo replaced the author and committer email of all 24 commits with the GitHub noreply address and removed four Codex session IDs (threadId, sessionId, windowId, itemId) from the first Codex live acceptance commit. Only that commit's tree changed, author dates were kept, and commit references in messages were remapped. All 25 commits on GitHub carry the noreply address.
publication.secret_scan: Before the push, every commit was searched for OpenAI, GitHub, AWS, Slack and private keys, bearer tokens, OAuth client secrets and database URLs with passwords. The only database URLs with passwords were test fixtures using SENSITIVE_DATABASE_CANARY. No file contained a local home path or a personal email address.

clean_install.environment: a new scratch HOME with an empty uv cache, PATH limited to the uv directory, /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin and /sbin, no API keys, macOS on Apple silicon
clean_install.python: The system Python on PATH was 3.9.6, below requires-python >=3.13, so uv downloaded CPython 3.14.6.
clean_install.probe: A script sent initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list and one tools/call for https://github.com/pallets/flask/issues/6146, then closed stdin.

runs.later_start_network: uv performed a Git fetch on every start
runs.offline_start: failed: uv could not fetch the repository with UV_OFFLINE=1

runs.later_start_network: uv performed a Git fetch on every start
runs.offline_start: failed: failed to fetch branch or tag v0.1.0

runs.later_start_network: uv used the existing Git source without a fetch

result_for_every_start.tool_call: isError true: Set OPENAI_API_KEY in ~/.config/issuelens/.env or in the MCP server's environment, then restart the MCP server.

clean_install.first_start_note: Both first starts include cloning the repository, downloading Python and installing about 38 packages. 10.7 seconds exceeds the Codex default startup timeout of 10 seconds, which the README raises with startup_timeout_sec = 30.

file_url_comparison: Before the tag was pushed, a scratch bare clone was tested through git+file:// with a test tag. There a tag pin also fetched on every start, but an offline start succeeded. Over https the tag pin failed offline, so the README commit that tag v0.1.0 points to says offline starts work; the next commit on main corrects it. The tag was not moved.
readme_choice: The README pins @v0.1.0: users get a fixed release that new commits on main do not change, at the cost of upgrading by hand. Each start still needs GitHub, which an analysis needs anyway. A full commit SHA avoids the fetch but is harder to read and upgrade.
checks: 346 tests passed and 28 were skipped without a database; Pyright reported no errors.
not_verified: A real analysis from Claude Code or Codex with the GitHub install; the real analyses used a local git+file install of the earlier commit 991ce41
